newsitem.title: USA: Golden Triangle okays stock/cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: Golden Triangle okays stock/cash dividend.

text.p: Golden Triangle Industries Inc said Tuesday its board has approved the issuance of a stock and cash dividend to its shareholders.
Shawna Owens, a spokeswoman for the company, said the amount of the dividend and payment date are not yet determined.
The company said its board also approved a one-for-3.5 reverse split, to be effective on May 20. It said fractional shares wil be rounded up to the next whole share.
In another development, it said its board approved creation of a new corporation to drill on low-risk domestic oil and gas properties.
A stock dividend will be issued to Golden Triangle shareholders in the new company, Owens said.
